'''Adar 27 (May 9)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - After surviving the [[Great Blight]], [[Rand]]'s party reaches the [[Eye of the World]] and meets the [[Green Man]]. They confront and kill [[Aginor]] and [[Balthamel]]. The Green Man dies, the Eye is drained of ''[[saidin]]'', and the [[Horn of Valere]], a broken [[seal]], and the [[Dragon Banner]] are discovered.
*{{ne|998}} - [[Fal Dara]]'s army claims victory over the [[Trolloc]]s at [[Tarwin's Gap]].
